text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Another summer with Super Creek is<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's filled with emotion over<n>realizing how much
I've matured<n>since last year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a bond so strong you could<n>almost call it
familial, we look towards<n>the fall race as our final
summer<n>camp together begins!
